create_autotrain_project_local: create an AutoTrainProject with LLMTrainingParams and local backend to start training
create_autotrain_project_spaces: create an AutoTrainProject with TextClassificationParams and spaces-a10g-large backend for cloud training
process_tabular_data: use tabular_munge_data to preprocess tabular classification or regression data for AutoTrain
process_llm_data: use llm_munge_data to preprocess language model training data with text and prompt columns
process_image_classification_data: use img_clf_munge_data to preprocess image classification dataset for AutoTrain training
